name: 45381 · W Alexandria, OH
findings: ZIP 45381 (W Alexandria) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45381 (W Alexandria) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
